candidates.label: Softer lip transition and less exposed teeth

stats.designLabel: Reduced neck exposure and raised collar fit

stats.designLabel: Softer chin and slimmer nasal bridge

stats.designLabel: Integrated skull, neck and nose correction

stats.designLabel: Gentler, narrower smile

stats.designLabel: Recessed oral cavity and rounded lips

candidates.label: Lifted smile corners and softened nasal crease

stats.designLabel: Lifted smile corners and softened nasal crease

candidates.label: Moderate cavity depth and balanced smile

candidates.label: Moderate chin projection

stats.designLabel: Moderate chin projection

stats.designLabel: Stronger chin and reduced nasal tip

stats.designLabel: Balanced lower-face and nasal contour

stats.designLabel: Curved auricle, helix and conchal bowl

stats.designLabel: Smaller auricle with backward upper tilt

candidates.label: Moderate ear size and quieter skin tint

stats.designLabel: Moderate ear size and quieter skin tint

stats.designLabel: Compact ear and softer helix presentation

stats.designLabel: Raised scalp boundary and exposed concha

stats.designLabel: Compact ear with wider scalp clearance

stats.designLabel: Balanced auricle and swept-back hairline
